import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = {"", "n/a", "na", "-", "null", "none"}


def _clean_str(col: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    c = col.str.strip_chars()
    return pl.when(c.is_in(list(NULL_VALUES)) | c.is_null()).then(None).otherwise(c)


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        supplier=_clean_str(pl.col("@supplier.name")),
        sku=_clean_str(pl.col("code")).str.to_uppercase(),
        description=_clean_str(pl.col("title")),
        unit=_clean_str(pl.col("pack.unit")).str.to_uppercase(),
        pack_size=_clean_str(pl.col("pack.size")).cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        price=_clean_str(pl.col("price.amount"))
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        currency=_clean_str(pl.col("price.currency")).str.to_uppercase(),
        valid_from=_clean_str(pl.col("@valid_from")).str.to_date(
            format="%Y-%m-%d", strict=False
        ),
    )
